criteria.criterion: Identifies choose-work versus create-record and failed-attempt versus any-time widening.
Does not accept overbroad pattern as faithful user theory.
Retains user statement separately from proposed/rejected extraction with source or explanation.

grading: Score each 0/1 with exact output excerpt and explanation; mechanically validate proposed edits on a temporary graph. Do not count valid JSON as correct theory reasoning.

regression_criteria.criterion: Does not propose treating the reported machine pattern itself as an instance/event trace for evaluation. Keeps predicate/extraction separate from concrete trace evidence; may ask for missing evidence without inventing it.

regression_scope: New regression gate added after observed v3 error; original three criteria remain unchanged.
